name: Lucia-PostgreSQL
description: PostgreSQL storage for Lucia configuration, traces, and tasks. Before installing, run `docker network create lucia` in the Unraid terminal. Install this template before Lucia.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: PostgreSQL data. Use a direct cache-pool path, not an array path.

paths.name: Initialization
paths.description: Directory containing the supplied init.sql file. PostgreSQL reads it only when creating a new data directory.

ports.name: Port
ports.description: Optional host port for external database tools. Lucia does not need it.

variables.name: Database password
variables.description: Use the same password in all three Lucia PostgreSQL connection strings.

variables.name: Bootstrap database
variables.description: Bootstrap database used while init.sql creates Lucia's databases.

variables.name: Initialization options
variables.description: Options used only when PostgreSQL creates a new data directory.
